resources.string: This plugin relays CoT between WearTAK watches and ATAK EUDs using the existing direct BLE transport for Samsung/Wear OS watches and an optional Garmin Connect IQ transport via Garmin Connect Mobile. It also allows WearTAK settings to be configured via ATAK EUD.\n\nDISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A. Approved for public release: distribution unlimited.
